title: Combinatorial twisted bialgebras and combinatorial twisted double bialgebras
summary: We provide in this text a new framework for a family of combinatorial Hopf algebras. We adopt for this the language of species and twisted bialgebras (also known as Hopf monoids). We define the category of combinatorial twisted bialgebras (briefly, CTBs), a class of twisted bialgebras satisfying strong combinatorial conditions of compatibilities of the product and the coproduct with the underlying combinatorial structure.
